exit_code.description:
Process exit code. Only present when finished is true and the process
exited normally (not killed by signal or failed to start).

finished.description: Whether the command has finished executing.

pid.description: PID of the spawned process. Absent if the process failed to start.

inactivity_timeout.description: Idle duration after which the sandbox is automatically terminated.

sandbox.CreateDirectoryRequest.description: Selects a sandbox directory to create and whether to create its parents.

parents.description: Defaults to true, which also succeeds when the directory already exists.

path.description: Absolute UTF-8 path of the directory.

sandbox.CreateDirectoryResponse.description: Confirms that the requested directory exists.

sandbox_id.description: Client-supplied ID that becomes the final path segment of the resource name.

sandbox.DeletePathRequest.description: Selects a sandbox path to delete and whether to delete its contents.

path.description: Absolute UTF-8 path of the entry to delete.

sandbox.DeletePathResponse.description: Confirms that the requested path is absent.

image_uri.description:
The Unity Catalog container image to use for the sandbox environment
(for example, `catalog.schema.folder.image:tag`). See
[Artifact Registry](https://docs.databricks.com/en/artifact-registry/).

sandbox.ExecuteCommandStatus.description: Terminal status of a unary command execution.

sandbox.ExecuteCommandSyncRequest.description: Request to run a command in the given sandbox and wait for it to finish.

envs.description:
Extra environment variables for the command's process, merged over the
sandbox's default environment.

execution_timeout.description:
Maximum time to wait for the command to finish. When it elapses the
command is terminated and the response carries status `TIMED_OUT`. The
server applies a default when unset and clamps to an upper bound; negative
or otherwise invalid durations are rejected with `INVALID_ARGUMENT`.

sandbox.ExecuteCommandSyncResponse.description:
Result of a completed unary command execution: captured output, exit code,
and terminal status.

command_id.description:
Daemon-generated identifier for this command execution, for correlation
(for example in `ListCommands`).

exit_code.description:
Process exit code. Unset when the process was terminated by a signal
(e.g. on `TIMED_OUT`) or never started (`FAILED`) rather than exiting
normally.

status.description:
Terminal status of the command execution. Always set on a successful
response; never `EXECUTE_COMMAND_STATUS_UNSPECIFIED`.

stderr.description: Captured standard error, with the same UTF-8 semantics as `stdout`.

stdout.description:
Captured standard output as UTF-8 text. Invalid UTF-8 bytes are replaced
with the Unicode replacement character (U+FFFD).

truncated.description:
True when `stdout` / `stderr` were truncated because the captured output
exceeded the server's per-response size cap. The dropped output is not
included in this response and is not recoverable through this unary API.

path.description: Absolute UTF-8 path of the entry to inspect.

sandbox.GetMetadataResponse.description: Contains metadata for the requested path without following its final symlink.

page_size.description:
Maximum number of commands to return. The server may return fewer.
If unspecified, the server returns all commands.

page_token.description:
Page token returned by a previous ListCommands call. Use this to
retrieve the next page of results.

commands.description: Commands in this page of results.

next_page_token.description: Token to retrieve the next page. Empty when there are no more results.

page_size.description: Zero uses the default of 1000; values above 1000 are clamped to 1000.

page_token.description: The token from a prior response. Keep parent and path unchanged between pages.

path.description: Absolute UTF-8 path of the directory.

sandbox.ListDirectoryContentsResponse.description:
Contains a page of immediate directory entries and an optional continuation token.
An empty token marks the final page. Pages reflect concurrent directory changes.

sandbox.RenamePathRequest.description: Identifies the source and exact destination for a sandbox path rename.

destination.description: Exact absolute UTF-8 destination; it must not already exist.

sandbox.RenamePathResponse.description: Confirms that the sandbox path was renamed.

sandbox.Sandbox.description: A Sandbox resource representing an execution environment.

create_time.description: Output only. The creation time of the sandbox.

display_name.description: Human-readable display label for the sandbox. At most 256 characters.

name.description:
The sandbox resource name, in the form `sandboxes/{sandbox_id}`. Derived from
`sandbox_id`; any value supplied in a create or update request body is ignored.

spec.description: The desired configuration of the sandbox, supplied by the caller at creation time.

status.description: The observed runtime state of the sandbox, populated by the server.

update_time.description: Output only. The last update time of the sandbox metadata and spec.

sandbox.SandboxFileInfo.description: Metadata for a sandbox filesystem entry, describing a final symlink itself.

modify_time.description: Nanosecond precision is preserved on the wire.

sandbox.SandboxFileType.description: Type of a sandbox filesystem entry without following its final symlink.

custom_tags.description:
Key-value tags associated with the sandbox. Supports up to 54 tags. Keys must be between
1 and 512 characters, and values must not exceed 256 characters.

compute.description: Compute configuration (size, inactivity timeout) requested for the sandbox.

environment.description: The execution environment to use for the sandbox.

sandbox.SandboxState.description:
Lifecycle state of a Sandbox resource. STOPPING is the transient state while the
sandbox is being stopped -- by a Stop request or inactivity auto-termination
-- and settles to STOPPED once the operation completes.

sandbox.StartSandboxRequest.description: A request to start a Sandbox.

sandbox.StopSandboxRequest.description: A request to stop a Sandbox.

sandbox.description:
The Sandbox resource carrying new field values. Only fields named in
`update_mask` are read; unmasked fields are ignored.

update_mask.description:
Field paths to update. Must be a non-empty subset of:
- display_name
- spec.compute.inactivity_timeout
Any other path returns INVALID_PARAMETER_VALUE.
